ident.description: The ident the route takes it by, uppercase: an airport's or a named fix's, two to five letters and figures; null for the pilot's own point (a user waypoint, a GPX point named in words), which the host names off the nearest fix.

name.description: The file's own name for it, where that is not the ident.

kind.description: What the file says it is (an .fpl's waypoint-type, a GPX point's type or sym); whether a field is open is field_status's, never this.
